name: Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon
effectText: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon this card. If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other card from your hand or face-up field on the bottom of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Main Deck to your hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon" once per turn.
